title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.37645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling, but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of Large Language Models. Recently, Multi-State Linear Attention (MSLA) mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. MSLA aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys, ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. In order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation, we propose MERLIN (MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention), a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. Using the moments of keys, a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment

translated_title: 具有广义二阶路由的多状态线性注意力
translated_abstract: 自注意力在长序列建模中起着关键作用，但其二次方的时间复杂度从根本上限制了大型语言模型的扩展。最近，多状态线性注意力（MSLA）机制被提出，通过将上下文分割成片段并将每个片段压缩到各自的记忆状态中，使序列建模更加高效。然而，MSLA仅使用查询与每个片段键之间的平均对齐来聚合从各记忆状态中提取的信息，忽略了对齐在片段内部的分布情况。为了更全面地建模片段与查询的相关性，并在聚合过程中纳入对齐的方差信息，我们提出了MERLIN（多状态线性注意力的矩路由），该方法跟踪每个片段键的一阶矩和二阶矩。利用键的矩信息，查询可以恢复其与每个片段对齐的均值和方差。
tldr: 提出MERLIN方法，通过跟踪每个片段键的一阶矩和二阶矩，使查询能够同时利用对齐的均值和方差信息来路由多状态线性注意力，突破传统方法仅依赖平均对齐的局限。
en_tdlr: MERLIN tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys, enabling queries to recover both the mean and variance of their alignment with each segment, generalizing multi-state linear attention routing beyond mean-only aggregation.
